title: One Hacker's AI Agents Broke Into 100+ Companies' Sites
description:
One hacker pointed a swarm of AI agents at more than 1,200 websites, and Reuters reports they reached sites at more than 100 companies, including John Deere and SharkNinja.
We bust two myths: big hacks need a big team, and AI hacking is expensive. A researcher roughly estimates about $50 of AI per break-in. It's still unclear if any data was taken.
